notes.text: We've resolved an issue where default filter values in a variant were not restored during the initial loading of the object page when no prior navigation state was available
We now ensure that saved variants are applied only after the smart table is fully initialized on the initial launch of the list report page
We've now assigned a ContentInfo landmark role to the footer of the list report page to improve accessibility for screen reader users
We've resolved an issue where the currency and unit columns in Insights cards generated from the list report page displayed unformatted values instead of locale-specific formatted numbers
The discard draft popup is no longer displayed when intent-based navigation links on the object page are opened in a new browser tab or window
We've resolved an issue with duplicate cross-app navigation requests that were triggered by rapidly double-clicking an intent-based navigation link
We've resolved an issue where an error could occur in the smart table or smart chart if the user navigated away from a page before its state was saved
